data.conditioning: Zero-initialized equivariant4to8 branch on observed centre-minus5x5quadratic-fit residual, correct centre covariance in variance, standardized and bounded to8 feature units. No signal clipping.
data.noise_gate_policy: Each positive level: RGB MSE full/parent<=.98, opponent full/parent<=1, full/without_correction RGB<=1; weak/edge gradient>=.95 parent. Zero noise retains original12gates, new mixed and historical20/80.
data.training_policy: Final2048 only, both pretrained seeds, same ID/phase schedule; noise level=(4*(step-1)+position)%3, seed74000000+4*(step-1)+position, same realizations across models. Adam scope=cfa_front; no early stopping.

checkpoint_policy.boundary: After completed Adam step only; restart partial microbatch from last committed checkpoint.
checkpoint_policy.selection: One atomic latest checkpoint, no validation scores or best-checkpoint selection.
checkpoint_policy.state: CPU model, Adam, completed step, losses, exposure counts, torch CPU RNG; data/noise draws derive deterministically from step.

limits: Independent Gaussian CFA noise with variance a*max(clean signal,0)+b, before demosaicing; not a sensor calibration.
Sigma estimated from observed signal and known simulation coefficients, not from clean truth.
Noisy bilinear reference in tempered loss; its energy includes noise as well as content.
Three-sigma bounded front correction; joint fine tuning can alter the trunk, cfa_front freezes it and skips gradient-free zero-noise anchors.
Frozen parent has fewer training steps; disabling correction in the trained model isolates the front-end contribution but is not an independently optimized witness.
Same procedural families and fixed4phase generator, not photographic validation.

plan.policy: One new52-truth cohort, three fixed noise draws per positive case, both models; no refitting, seed selection or threshold changes.
limits: Same procedural generators; not photographic, sensor or unseen noise-level validation.
Zero-noise observations and historical controls replayed across replicas; not independent measurements.
Three positive noise draws are independent across replicas, paired identically across model seeds.
